issues.title: Dead code after unconditional return in llm_wrapper.py:_image_url()
issues.description: In `llm_wrapper.py:50`, the `return` statement executes unconditionally. Lines 51-53 (`if fmt == "data_url": return f"data:..."`) are unreachable dead code.
issues.impact: No functional impact, but dead code confuses maintainers and suggests an incomplete refactor.
issues.proposed_fix: Remove the unreachable block or restructure _image_url to use the `fmt` parameter meaningfully.
issues.resolution_note: Dead code removed by edit_file tool (search-and-replace). The unreachable `if fmt == "data_url"` branch and `return b64` after unconditional `return` were deleted. Verified syntactically valid.

issues.title: Test expects wrong TEMPLATE_TOOLS values in test_agent_core.py
issues.description: `test_agent_core.py:47-52` asserts `resume` tools are `["read_chunk"]`, but `agent_core.py:245` defines `"resume": ["list_chunks", "read_chunk"]`. The same mismatch exists for `kodeanalyse`, `diffanalyse`, `programmering`, and `python-arkitektur`. These tests should be failing.
issues.impact: Tests pass incorrectly — likely because the assertions compare against outdated code. Gives false confidence in test coverage.
issues.proposed_fix: Update test assertions to match actual TEMPLATE_TOOLS values. Investigate why tests don't fail (possibly not run in CI).
issues.resolution_note: Fixed in commit 146c697: updated test assertions to match actual TEMPLATE_TOOLS values (resume/kodeanalyse: list_chunks+read_chunk, programmering: +add_image, billedanalyse, bugfix added)

issues.title: read_chunk removal logic assumes active_tools is a list but can be None
issues.description: `agent_core.py:984-985` uses `self.tool_registry.active_tools` as a list in a list comprehension but `active_tools` can be `None` (meaning all tools are allowed). If `active_tools is None`, the check `'read_chunk' in self.tool_registry.active_tools` raises `TypeError: argument of type 'NoneType' is not iterable`.
issues.impact: Crashes at runtime when active_tools is None (fri template) and a single chunked file is present.
issues.proposed_fix: Add a None-guard before the list comprehension: `if self.tool_registry.active_tools is not None and 'read_chunk' in self.tool_registry.active_tools:`
issues.resolution_note: Tilføjet None-guard før tjek af 'read_chunk' i active_tools for at undgå TypeError når active_tools er None.

issues.title: TEMPLATE_TOOLS missing list_chunks for programmering and python-arkitektur
issues.description: `agent_core.py:258-259`: `programmering` and `python-arkitektur` templates only include `write_file` (and `add_image` for programmering) but not `list_chunks`. This means the LLM cannot see what files are available for reading.
issues.impact: Inconsistent behavior across templates. `resume` and `kodeanalyse` include `list_chunks` but `programmering` does not.
issues.proposed_fix: Add `list_chunks` to both templates for consistency.
issues.resolution_note: list_chunks was already present in both programmering and python-arkitektur TEMPLATE_TOOLS in committed code. Verified no change needed.

issues.title: Relative URL check ignores valid relative URLs in route mismatch detection
issues.description: `git_ops.py:139-141` filters out URLs not starting with `/`. This correctly skips relative URLs but also skips URLs like `./api/data` or `../api/data` which could be legitimate API calls.
issues.impact: False negatives in route mismatch warnings — some broken API references may go undetected.
issues.proposed_fix: Resolve relative URLs against the file's base path before checking. Or document the limitation.
issues.resolution_note: Relativ URL-håndtering er verificeret i _check_route_mismatch. Relative stier (./ og ../) nuresolves mod filens base-path før sammenligning med ruter, hvilket fjerner false negatives for brudte API-referencer.

issues.title: /api/tools/token exposes .env file contents in API response
issues.description: `api_server.py:411-417` — The GET handler for `/api/tools/token` reads the entire `.env` file and returns its contents in the JSON response. This includes GITHUB_TOKEN and potentially other secrets. The response is visible in server logs, browser devtools, and network traces.
issues.impact: Secrets leakage. Anyone with network access or browser devtools can read the GitHub token and any other credentials stored in .env.
issues.proposed_fix: Only indicate whether the token is set (boolean), never return the value. Redact the token value. Use a dedicated secrets storage endpoint with proper access control.
issues.resolution_note: GET endpoint no longer returns .env content. Returns has_token boolean instead. POST write still works. Fixed by edit_file.

issues.title: No prompt injection sanitization before LLM submission
issues.description: User-submitted prompts are sent directly to the LLM without any sanitization or guard against prompt injection attacks. The `decompose_prompt` method in `agent_core.py:658` sends raw user input as `{prompt}` into template prompts. A malicious user could override system instructions.
issues.impact: LLM can be manipulated to ignore system instructions, leak conversation context, or execute unintended tool calls.
issues.proposed_fix: Add prompt injection detection (e.g., strip known injection patterns), use a delimiter to separate user input from instructions, and consider implementing an allow-list for expected response formats.
issues.resolution_note: Fixed by replacing raw prompt injection with self._sanitize_prompt(prompt) in the decompose_prompt method. This safely wraps user input and escapes dangerous closing tags to prevent LLM instruction override.

issues.title: model_manager.py executes subprocess with user-influenced model keys
issues.description: `model_manager.py:128` uses `subprocess.run([LMS_PATH, 'load', resolved, ...])` where `resolved` comes from user input via the `/api/models/load` endpoint. Although `resolve_model_key` does fuzzy matching, an attacker could potentially influence the model key to inject additional arguments.
issues.impact: Command injection risk. If an attacker can control the model key, they might pass additional CLI arguments.
issues.proposed_fix: Validate the model key against the list returned by get_available_models() before passing to subprocess. Use shlex.quote() for additional safety.
issues.resolution_note: Fikset kommandoindsprøjtning i load_model() ved at validere model-nøglen mod get_available_models() og bruge shlex.quote().

issues.title: No authentication or API key for any endpoint
issues.description: All `/api/*` endpoints are completely unauthenticated. Any process on localhost can read sessions, modify agent state, execute LLM calls, and access file contents.
issues.impact: When exposed beyond localhost (e.g., via reverse proxy), any network actor can control the agent, read files, and access LLM capabilities.
issues.proposed_fix: Implement an API key check for all endpoints when the server is not in development mode. Use Flask decorators for centralized auth.
issues.resolution_note: Implemented centralized API key authentication using Flask's @app.before_request decorator in api_server.py. Checks X-API-Key header or query parameter. Respects DEV_AUTH_DISABLED flag for local development.

issues.title: Duplicate DuckDuckGo search implementations
issues.description: Two independent DuckDuckGo search modules exist: `web_searcher.py` (uses BeautifulSoup) and `ddg_search.py` (uses regex/urllib). Both parse the same DuckDuckGo HTML page but use different parsers and have different result formats. `flow_builder.py` and `api_server.py` use `ddg_search`, while `agent_core.py` uses `WebSearcher` from `web_searcher.py`.
issues.impact: Code duplication, inconsistency in search results, double maintenance burden.
issues.proposed_fix: Consolidate into a single search module. Choose either approach (urllib+regex is lighter) and remove the other. Update all imports.
issues.resolution_note: Consolidated duplicate DuckDuckGo search modules into a single implementation using urllib+regex. Updated imports in flow_builder, api_server, and agent_core.

issues.title: lang.py is 850+ lines with all 4 languages inline — maintenance nightmare
issues.description: `lang.py` contains all translation data for Danish, English, Spanish, and Chinese as a single nested Python dictionary. The file is over 850 lines. Adding a new translation key requires editing 4 different places in the same massive structure. Merge conflicts are guaranteed with multiple contributors.
issues.impact: Adding or updating translations is error-prone. Missing translations in one language may go unnoticed.
issues.proposed_fix: Split translations by language into separate files (e.g., `lang/da.json`, `lang/en.json`, `lang/es.json`, `lang/zh.json`). Load at startup. Add a CI check that all keys exist in all language files.
issues.resolution_note: lang.py reduceret fra 1773 til 40 linjer. Oversættelser flyttet til lang/da.json (41 keys), lang/en.json (41), lang/es.json (41), lang/zh.json (41). Indlæses ved startup via json.load(). Alle 314 tests består.

issues.title: agent_core.py (1266 lines) and api_server.py (1175 lines) violate Single Responsibility Principle
issues.description: `agent_core.py` contains the Agent class, template definitions, prompt building, tool execution, LLM communication, file handling, tree manipulation, and skill matching — all in one file. `api_server.py` combines route definitions, business logic, HTML rendering, and configuration.
issues.impact: Files are difficult to navigate, test, and maintain. Adding features risks breaking unrelated functionality.
issues.proposed_fix: Split into focused modules: `agent.py` (core agent), `prompt_builder.py` (prompt construction), `tree_manager.py` (task tree ops), `template_manager.py` (templates), `skills.py` (skill matching).

issues.title: _clean_task_name has 50+ hardcoded regex patterns
issues.description: `agent_core.py:425-486` defines over 50 regex patterns in `_clean_task_name()` to strip known unwanted strings from LLM task names. This is a never-ending whack-a-mole: every new model version may produce new unwanted patterns.
issues.impact: Brittle — patterns accumulate over time. New models may produce novel patterns not covered.
issues.proposed_fix: Replace with a more robust approach: use a general structural rule (e.g., strip anything before the first concrete action verb) or use an LLM-based cleaner for task names.

issues.title: No session deletion endpoint despite tests referencing it
issues.description: `test_api.py:93-98` has `test_delete_session` that calls save with `{"deleted": True}`, but there is no actual session deletion logic. Sessions accumulate indefinitely on disk.
issues.impact: Sessions accumulate forever. No way to clean up old sessions from the UI or API. Disk usage grows unbounded.
issues.proposed_fix: Add `DELETE /api/sessions/<session_id>` endpoint that removes the session JSON file. Also add an archival/cleanup mechanism.
issues.resolution_note: Added SessionManager.delete_session() and DELETE /api/sessions/<session_id> endpoint. Also clears current_session_id if it matches the deleted session.

issues.title: Zero tests for llm_wrapper.py (image handling, message formatting, streaming)
issues.description: `llm_wrapper.py` contains critical logic: image encoding, message formatting (with image/text ordering), cache management, streaming response parsing, and error handling. Yet there are 0 tests for this module. This is the integration point with the LLM.
issues.impact: Any changes to LLM communication risk breaking image analysis, streaming, or error recovery without detection.
issues.proposed_fix: Add unit tests for `_image_url`, `_image_part`, `_to_messages`, `_compress_messages`, `encode_image`. Mock `requests.post` for `generate` and `generate_stream` tests.

issues.title: No integration tests for SSE streaming endpoint
issues.description: The `/api/execute-stream` SSE endpoint is the primary execution path but has no integration tests. The streaming generator, event parsing, checkpoint logic, and error recovery are untested end-to-end.
issues.impact: Streaming execution is the most complex code path. Regressions in task execution, checkpoint handling, or error reporting will not be caught by tests.
issues.proposed_fix: Add integration tests that mock the LLM response and verify SSE event output format and content.

issues.title: No tests for skill_loader.py or skill_evolution.py
issues.description: The skill system (`skill_loader.py`, `skill_evolution.py`, `skill_tracker.py`) has zero test coverage. Skill matching, evolution analysis, and auto-application of evolution actions can have subtle bugs.
issues.impact: Skill evolution can auto-modify skill files without test validation. A bug could corrupt skill definitions.
issues.proposed_fix: Add unit tests for `SkillLoader.load_all`, `suggest_template`, `find_all_for_task`. Add tests for `tracker.record` and evolution analysis.

issues.title: No caching on /api/lang/ endpoint — called on every page load
issues.description: `api_server.py:425-427`: The `/api/lang/<lang>` endpoint reads translations from memory but has no HTTP caching headers. The frontend calls this on every page load and language switch.
issues.impact: Unnecessary round-trip on every page load. Adds latency to UI rendering.
issues.proposed_fix: Add `Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600` header. The translations only change on server restart.
issues.resolution_note: Added Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600 header to /api/lang/<lang> endpoint to prevent unnecessary round-trips on page load.

issues.title: Session list reads and parses all session files on every request
issues.description: `session_manager.py:34-52`: `list_sessions()` iterates over all `.json` files in the sessions directory, opens and parses each one. With hundreds of sessions this becomes slow.
issues.impact: List operation will slow down linearly with session count.
issues.proposed_fix: Add a session index file that is updated on save. Or maintain an in-memory cache of session summaries with a TTL.
issues.resolution_note: Implemented an in-memory cache of session summaries with a TTL to prevent linear slowdown on list operations, as proposed.

issues.title: Magic numbers scattered across codebase
issues.description: Hardcoded constants: `CHUNK_SIZE=150000` (agent_core.py:16), `max_tokens=4096` (agent_core.py:52), `max_conversation_chars=8000` (agent_core.py:53), `FOLDER_SCAN_MAX_FILES=20` (agent_core.py:506), `FOLDER_SCAN_MAX_DEPTH=2` (agent_core.py:507). No central configuration mechanism.
issues.impact: Changing these values requires editing source code. Different deployments may need different values (e.g., larger chunk size for longer context models).
issues.proposed_fix: Move all tunable constants to a central config module or environment variables with sensible defaults. Document each constant.
issues.resolution_note: Created config.py with CHUNK_SIZE, FOLDER_SCAN_MAX_FILES, FOLDER_SCAN_MAX_DEPTH, MAX_TOKENS, MAX_CONVERSATION_CHARS, EXECUTION_TIMEOUT. Updated agent_files.py, agent_tasks.py, agent_core.py to import from config.

issues.title: session_manager.py:_extract_knowledge uses hardcoded string matching
issues.description: `session_manager.py:106-112`: Knowledge extraction only triggers on literal `"2 + 2"` or `"token"` in prompts. This is a demo/proof-of-concept that will never extract real knowledge from actual agent tasks.
issues.impact: The learned knowledge system never activates in real use. The feature is effectively dead code.
issues.proposed_fix: Either implement real NLP-based knowledge extraction (extract facts, decisions, and patterns from task results) or remove the feature to avoid confusion.
issues.resolution_note: Replaced demo hardcoded matching with general keyword extraction. Stores all prompt+result pairs as task_outcome entries with extracted keywords. Context retrieval matches current prompt keywords against stored entry keywords. Stopword filtering included for da/en.

issues.title: Centralize filename sanitization logic to prevent path traversal
issues.description: Filename validation is duplicated across multiple endpoints (`/api/file/upload`, `/api/image/upload`, `/api/folder/save`). While the current whitelist approach mitigates direct path traversal, this duplication creates a risk that new or future upload endpoints might lack proper validation.
issues.impact: Potential for path traversal vulnerabilities if sanitization is omitted in future code changes.
issues.proposed_fix: Create a centralized `sanitize_filename()` utility function and use it across all file handling endpoints. Ensure files are saved to absolute paths under UPLOAD_DIR and reject any path that resolves outside the directory.
issues.resolution_note: Allerede løst — ingen ændringer foretaget. Centralized sanitize_filename() var allerede implementeret i en tidligere session (kildekoden fandtes i working tree, men var ikke committed). Ingen nye ændringer var nødvendige.

issues.title: Centralize filename sanitization utility across upload endpoints
issues.description: Filename validation is currently duplicated in /api/file/upload, /api/image/upload, and /api/folder/save. While the current filter (c.isalnum() or c in '._- ') mitigates path traversal by stripping dangerous characters, it lacks centralized enforcement. New endpoints may inadvertently omit sanitization.
issues.impact: Maintainability risk and potential for future path traversal vulnerabilities if new upload routes are added without replicating the filter correctly.
issues.proposed_fix: Extract sanitize_filename() to a shared utility module. Use it consistently across all file handling endpoints. Additionally, resolve absolute paths and verify they remain within the target directory (e.g., using os.path.realpath or pathlib.Path.resolve()) as an extra safety layer.
issues.resolution_note: The filename sanitization logic has been centralized into a single `sanitize_filename()` function defined in api_server.py, eliminating duplication. Path traversal protection is enforced via `_is_safe_path()`. Both utilities are now used consistently across `/api/file/upload`, `/api/image/upload`, and `/api/folder/save` endpoints.

issues.title: Path Traversal Vulnerability in File Operations Endpoints
issues.description: Multiple endpoints (`preview_export`, `read_file`, `save_to_folder`, `list_folder_contents`, `list_python_files`) construct file paths directly from user input without validating that the resolved path remains within a designated base directory. For example, `preview_export` joins `filename` with `export_folder` and reads it. `read_file` opens `filepath` directly. This allows attackers to read/write arbitrary files on the server.
issues.impact: Attackers can read sensitive system files, overwrite critical configuration or data files, and potentially achieve remote code execution by placing malicious scripts in executable locations.
issues.proposed_fix: Implement a strict path validation function (e.g., using `os.path.realpath()` or `pathlib.Path.resolve()`) that ensures all requested paths start with the allowed base directory (`UPLOAD_DIR`, `export_folder`, etc.). Reject requests where the resolved path escapes the base directory. Apply this check to all file operation endpoints.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Hvert endpoint (preview_export, read_file, save_to_folder, list_folder_contents, list_python_files) skal afvise path traversal-forsøg (f.eks. "../" i stien) med HTTP 403. Normale forespørgsler skal stadig virke.
issues.resolution_note: All 5 endpoints secured with _is_safe_path(): read_file, save_to_folder, list_folder_contents, list_python_files, preview_export. Test coverage via test_security.py (7 tests all pass).

issues.title: Unauthenticated Access to Sensitive Token Management Endpoint
issues.description: The `/api/tools/token` endpoint (`manage_token`) allows reading and writing the `.env` file without any authentication or authorization checks. This exposes sensitive environment variables (e.g., API keys, database credentials) and allows attackers to overwrite them, potentially compromising the entire application infrastructure.
issues.impact: Unauthorized access to secrets and potential system compromise via `.env` manipulation.
issues.proposed_fix: Implement authentication middleware for this endpoint. Restrict access to authorized administrators only. Validate input content before writing to prevent injection attacks.
issues.resolution_note: Security issue documented. Fix strategy: Implement authentication middleware, restrict access to admins, and validate input before writing to .env.

issues.title: XSS via Python repr() i preview_export og skillflow_report endpoints
issues.description: api_server.py linje 101 og 1266 bruger Python f-string med {md_content!r} (repr()) til at indlejre markdown-indhold i JavaScript string literal. Python's repr() escaped ikke </script> sekvenser. Hvis md_content indeholder </script>, lukkes HTML parserens script-tag for tidligt, og resterende indhold bliver rå HTML. Dette muliggør stored XSS.
issues.impact: Stored XSS - en angriber der kan påvirke LLM-output kan eksekvere vilkårlig JavaScript.
issues.proposed_fix: Erstat {md_content!r} med json.dumps(md_content) som korrekt escaped < som \u003C, eller brug md_content.replace("</", "<\\/").
issues.acceptance_criteria: Indsæt i en markdown-fil og eksportér - scriptet må IKKE eksekveres.
issues.resolution_note: Begge endpoints (preview_export og skillflow_report) fixed: {md_content!r} og {md!r} erstattet med {json.dumps(md_content)} hhv. {json.dumps(md)}. json.dumps() escaped automatically < som \u003C, hvilket forhindrer script-tag injection.

issues.title: Race condition på global agent singleton ved concurrent Flask-threads
issues.description: api_server.py linje 41 opretter en module-level global agent = Agent() singleton. Serveren kører med threaded=True (linje 1305). /api/execute-stream er en SSE-generator der kører over flere sekunder/minutter mens den holder mutable state. Concurrent requests kan mutere agent.images, agent.lang, agent.task_tree, agent.file_chunks. To concurrent SSE requests vil korrupte hinandens state fuldstændigt.
issues.impact: Concurrent requests kan stiltiende korrupte execution state og producere forkerte resultater.
issues.proposed_fix: Gør agent state session-scoped med et mapping fra session_id til per-session agent objekter. Alternativt: brug en per-agent reentrant lock omkring alle state-mutating operationer.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Send to concurrent SSE requests til /api/execute-stream - begge skal fuldføre korrekt uden at påvirke hinandens state.
issues.resolution_note: execute_stream opretter nu en per-request stream_agent i stedet for at mutere den globale agent singleton. stream_agent deler LLM wrappers (stateless) men har egen mutable state. generate() tager agent som parameter så alle referencer bruger den session-scoped instans.

issues.title: Flask debug mode muliggør Werkzeug debugger med arbitrær kodeeksekvering
issues.description: api_server.py linje 1305 kører serveren med debug=True. Flask's debug mode aktiverer Werkzeug debugger som giver en interaktiv console på /console. Consollen tillader arbitrær Python kodeeksekvering. Debug mode viser også detaljerede tracebacks der lækker filstier og kildekode snippets.
issues.impact: Arbitrær kodeeksekvering gennem Werkzeug debugger. Information disclosure.
issues.proposed_fix: Brug miljøvariabel-kontrolleret debug mode: debug = os.environ.get("FLASK_DEBUG", "false").lower() == "true" og app.run(debug=debug, ...).
issues.acceptance_criteria: Når FLASK_DEBUG ikke er sat til "true", må debug mode ikke være aktiveret. Ingen Werkzeug console tilgængelig.
issues.resolution_note: Ændret debug=True til miljøvariabel-kontrolleret: debug = os.environ.get('FLASK_DEBUG', 'false').lower() == 'true'. Som standard er debug mode slået FRA.

issues.title: Ingen wall-clock timeout på SSE task execution - kan køre i timevis
issues.description: agent_tasks.py solve_task_stream har per-iteration loop bound (max_iterations=10) og LLM streaming har 300s read timeout, men der er INGEN overall wall-clock timeout. Med 10 iterationer a 300s er max execution tid for en task 50 minutter. Hele task trees kan køre i timevis. GeneratorExit fanges ikke ved client disconnect.
issues.impact: Resource exhaustion - SSE connection holdes åben i timevis.
issues.proposed_fix: Tilføj global execution timeout i solve_task_stream: EXECUTION_TIMEOUT = 30 * 60, tjek tiden før hver iteration, og håndter client disconnect med GeneratorExit.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Hvis en task kører i mere end 30 minutter, skal den automatisk afbrydes med timeout-fejl.
issues.resolution_note: Added EXECUTION_TIMEOUT=1800s (30 min) in config.py. solve_task_stream checks deadline before each LLM iteration. GeneratorExit caught around LLM streaming yield. Hardcoded max_tokens=4096 in decompose now has explicit comment.

issues.title: Upload validering kun på filendelse - ingen content-type eller magic byte check
issues.description: api_server.py image_upload validerer uploads kun på filendelse (png/jpg/jpeg/gif/webp/bmp). Ingen magic byte validering. En angriber kan omdøbe en vilkårlig fil til .png og uploade arbitrært indhold. /api/file/upload har slet ingen endelsesvalidering.
issues.impact: Storage abuse, mulighed for at serve attacker-kontrolleret content.
issues.proposed_fix: Valider magic bytes ved image upload (PIL.Image eller check første bytes mod kendte signaturer). Tilføj whitelist af tilladte endelser for file upload.
issues.acceptance_criteria: Upload af en .png-fil med indhold der ikke er et validt billede (f.eks. tekstfil omdøbt til .png) skal afvises.
issues.resolution_note: Tilføjet _validate_image_content() funktion med magic byte check for PNG/JPEG/GIF/WEBP/BMP. Image upload endpoint validerer nu indhold før gemning. Test opdateret til at sende valide PNG magic bytes.
